thought: The user wants a small portfolio template website implemented using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I need to create a plan that defines the structure, content sections, and implementation details, organizing the code into multiple files for modularity.
title: Small Portfolio Template Website

steps.title: Research Portfolio Website Structure and Design Patterns
steps.description: Research common sections included in a small portfolio website (e.g., Hero, About, Skills, Projects, Contact). Investigate simple, clean design patterns and basic responsive design techniques using CSS. Look for examples of how to structure HTML for semantic meaning and accessibility.
steps.note: This research will inform the content sections and basic layout of the template.

steps.title: Generate Conceptual Architecture Diagram
steps.description: Generate a high-level conceptual diagram illustrating the main components of the portfolio website: the User Interface (HTML/CSS) and the basic interactivity layer (JavaScript). Show how these components interact to present the portfolio content.
steps.note: This diagram visualizes the overall system architecture.

steps.title: Generate Project Directory Structure
steps.description: Generate the directory structure for the small portfolio template project. Create a root directory (e.g., `small_portfolio_template`) with subdirectories for static assets: `css`, `js`, and potentially `images`. Place `index.html` in the root. Within the `css` directory, create `style.css`. Within the `js` directory, create `script.js`.
steps.note: This sets up the organized file structure for the project.

steps.title: Generate Project Component Diagram with Directory Structure Context
steps.description: Generate a component diagram illustrating the main components of the portfolio project, reflecting their placement within the generated directory structure. Show the root directory and the `css`, `js`, and `images` subdirectories. Indicate key files like `index.html`, `css/style.css`, and `js/script.js` to show how the code structure maps to the physical directory layout.
steps.note: This diagram visualizes the physical structure of the project files and their roles.

steps.title: Verify File Paths and Dependencies
steps.description: Verify the correctness of file paths within the generated directory structure. Ensure that `index.html` can correctly reference `css/style.css` and `js/script.js`. Confirm that there are no complex JavaScript module dependencies requiring import/export statements for this simple template.
steps.note: This step confirms the logical connections between the project files and prepares for dependency resolution.

steps.title: Resolve and Correct Library Dependencies
steps.description: Identify any necessary external library dependencies and their versions. For this simple portfolio template using native browser APIs, confirm that no external libraries are strictly required or note if any minimal dependencies (like a CSS reset or a simple animation library) would be beneficial, though the plan is to use pure HTML/CSS/JS.
steps.note: This step ensures that any required libraries are identified with compatible versions, although for this project, it's mainly about confirming the use of native APIs.

steps.title: Plan Code Implementation Details
steps.description:
Create a detailed code plan for the `coder_master` to implement the small portfolio template. This plan should cover:

**HTML (`index.html`):**
- Structure the page with semantic HTML5 elements (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<section>`, `<footer>`).
- Include sections for: Hero/About, Skills, Projects, and Contact.
- Add placeholder content for each section.
- Link `css/style.css` in the `<head>`.
- Link `js/script.js` at the end of the `<body>`.
- Include basic navigation links in the `<nav>`.

**CSS (`css/style.css`):**
- Plan basic styling for layout (e.g., using Flexbox or Grid for sections).
- Define styles for typography, colors, and spacing.
- Plan styles for navigation, project cards/items, and contact form elements.
- Include basic responsive design considerations (e.g., media queries for different screen sizes).
- Plan a simple CSS reset or normalize.

**JavaScript (`js/script.js`):**
- Plan minimal JavaScript functionality, such as smooth scrolling for navigation links or a simple toggle for a mobile navigation menu (if included in the HTML plan).
- Ensure the script waits for the DOM to be fully loaded before executing.

Ensure the plan emphasizes a clean, readable structure and basic responsiveness.
steps.note: This comprehensive plan will guide the `coder_master` in writing all the necessary code for the template.

steps.title: Implement Portfolio Template Code
steps.description:
Write the complete code for the small portfolio template based on the detailed code plan. Implement:

**HTML (`index.html`):** Create the full HTML structure with all planned sections, placeholder content, navigation, and links to CSS and JS files.

**CSS (`css/style.css`):** Write all the CSS rules for layout, styling, and responsiveness as planned.

**JavaScript (`js/script.js`):** Write the minimal JavaScript code for smooth scrolling or mobile navigation toggle, ensuring it's correctly implemented and attached to the relevant HTML elements.

The output should be the complete `index.html`, `css/style.css`, and `js/script.js` files within the previously defined directory structure.
steps.note: This is the core implementation step where all the template code is written.

steps.title: Generate Project Report
steps.description:
Generate a final report summarizing the implemented small portfolio template website. Include:
- A brief overview of the project (a simple, responsive portfolio template).
- The technology stack used (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
- A description of the implemented sections (Hero/About, Skills, Projects, Contact) and basic features (e.g., responsiveness, smooth scrolling if implemented).
- An explanation of the file structure (`index.html`, `css/style.css`, `js/script.js`).
- Instructions on how to set up and run the template (e.g., opening `index.html` in a browser).
- Mention how users can customize the template with their own content and styles.
steps.note: This report provides a summary of the completed project, explains its structure, and gives instructions for use and customization.
